supported_conclusions.claim: Full segmentation setter entry 0x157fc copies region 5 [0x31da0,0x131f44), size 0x1001a4. Grid-only setter entry 0x15898 copies [0x31da4,0x131db0), size 0x10000c. Thus grid-only preserves four leading bytes plus the 404-byte tail; full replacement does not. Neither copy range includes room mappings or restriction arrays. This is byte-range preservation, not semantic preservation.

Navigation 0x12a35c gets shared segmentation at interior 0x12a39a and copies grid data; dimensions produce centered offsets by signed integer division by 2 and negation before round. Function 0x132c30 calls rs::segment_gridmap at 0x132f44, then conditionally processes IDs through 0x13223c (call 0x13324e). Before full publish it allocates and zeroes 0x1001a4 bytes at 0x1330ea..0x133102, copies 0x10000c bytes to +4 at 0x133110, sets presence at 0x133118 and calls SetSharedSegmentMap at 0x13311a. The 404-byte tail is zero on this publish path, not inherited from the previous shared tail.

In 0x13223c, old active-grid cells whose low six bits are 16..31 take a reuse branch (0x1324ba..0x1324d4). The write can regenerate bit 0x40 according to unresolved predicate 0x127804 (0x132488..0x132496). Other candidate labels can use a per-label byte mapping with IDs allocated from 1..15 (0x132450/0x132620..0x132634) and saturation to 15 (0x132956 onward). The branch is conditional, not a guarantee that segmentation preserves final room identity. Additional flood/postprocessing remains.

SetRoomIdMapping entry 0x15c84 independently copies 28-byte records, caps count to 32 and chooses the alternate array for enum value 1; default count/data are 0x131fac/0x131fb0 and alternate 0x13e9f0/0x13e9f4. Mapping IDs are read at record+24 by its logging loop. The public enum meaning, name encoding/termination and reconciliation of names after geometry changes are unresolved.

For captured flags 2/6 and application IDs 0/4, each 175890-cell IMAGE window agrees exactly with region-5 low-six-bit segmentation IDs using origin shifts +512 on both axes. Each pair has nine default mapping IDs covering all nonzero segmentation IDs; all are in the conditional 16..31 reuse range. Cell upper bits 0 and 0x40 both occur. The 404-byte tails are zero in both captures. This validates the captured relationship, not regeneration stability or arbitrary coordinate transforms. No names, coordinates or decoded payloads are committed.

rules: Preserve grid origin, dimensions, resolution, all cell bits and all persistence/mapping/restriction/opaque bytes.
Use one coherent source snapshot; lifecycle/cache/transaction rules are external blockers. No runtime restore guarantee.
Keeping metadata unchanged is mechanically possible, but fixed dimensions do not establish unchanged room connectivity, areas, names or restrictions.
Checksum repair validates only the grid cell digest, not metadata consistency.
No proof in this slice that edited RRSLAM load invokes this segmentation path; do not assume automatic regeneration.
Preserve/validate ID-to-name associations explicitly; local 16..31 reuse is conditional and 1..15 allocation exists.
Grid-only and full setters have different unknown-tail preservation rules. Do not clear unknown bytes merely to imitate this one native publish path.
Restriction bytes outside the segmentation copy survive physically, but their geometric meaning must still be validated.
